snippet.title: Angry Birds 2: A New Challenge!?
snippet.description:
A brand new event just launched in Angry Birds 2: The Golden Pig Challenge!
In this challenge you only get one bird, and to get more birds you have to pop the golden pig!
This is a strikes-only challenge where only the best will succeed.. will you?
